{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows after filtering: {len(df)}')

duplicates = df[df.duplicated(subset="patient_id", keep=False)]
print(f'Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {len(duplicates)}')
print(duplicates["patient_id"].value_counts().head())"}
